Parties have resolved the dispute and they have withdrawn all the allegations and counter allegations made against each other, on the ground of settlement and reunion.
Hence, they are seeking to quash the proceedings.
7. In the said facts and circumstances, no useful purpose will be served in keeping the proceedings pending against petitioner.

It is the duty of the Courts to encourage genuine settlements of matrimonial disputes, particularly, when the same are on considerable increase.

Section 320 of the Code, would not be a bar to the exercise of power of quashing of FIR.'
